Key Business Insights
note: this also suggests we move from flat monthly targets to a seasonally-weighted target curve" — It give reps a fairer, more realistic goal shape month to month.
Strong, repeating Q4 seasonality, two years running. Both 2024 and 2025 ramp from around August/September through a December peak (₹478.5M in Dec 2024, ₹524.5M in
Dec 2025), then fall off a cliff in January (₹268.3M) — roughly a 44% month-over-month drop right after the peak. Because this shape repeats almost identically across both
years, it's a structural pattern. this can help us planning inventory, staffing, and cash flow .
•
East underperforms primarily on revenue generation (48% below South), not on margin execution (only 1.2% below the best region) — the fix is demand/coverage in East.•
Discounting is not the primary margin driver for most of the team — the majority cluster is in the healthy Top-Performer zone regardless of discount level. Risk is concentrated
in a specific ~4-rep group discounting above 10.5%, not spread evenly across the sales force.
•
Hardware drives ~46% of revenue but only ~25% margin and the highest return rate — while Software, at just ~27% of revenue, runs ~76% margin. •
Enterprise leads on both revenue (39%) and margin (52.3%), SMB is the one segment lagging on both dimensions.•

It also reviewed chart reads during the build and caught one error — an initial misread of the Segment donut (Enterprise was reported as smallest/least
profitable; the data actually shows it's the largest segment by revenue and the highest-margin) — corrected before this submission.
